مُرْغِسٌ One who makes himself to have a plentiful and pleasant and easy life; (Ibn-'Abbád, Sgh, K;) as also with ش. (TA.) ―
-b2- A plentiful state of life; as also ↓ مُرْغَسٌ , (K,) in the saying هَمْ فِى مُرْغِسٍ مِنْ عَيْشِهِمْ [They are in a plentiful state of life]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
